# EffeTune documentation snapshot (Japanese)

- Commit: 01c96f00f8e93595aefab96de4bc4d210e61c53b
- Why this commit: it is the `external/effetune` submodule of EffeTune Mixwright v0.14.0,
  release commit e4147644305f0d373e362fc1485b4cb9889e5b63, the VST3 build bundled with mImageViewer.
